etymology_story.zh: 这是按现代医学命名方式构成的术语：希腊语来源的 hyper- 表示“过度”，parathyroid 指位于甲状腺附近的甲状旁腺，-ism 表示状态或病症。名称描述的是甲状旁腺激素分泌过多；其中 para- 的“在旁边”说明了腺体的位置。医学含义参见 [美国国家糖尿病、消化与肾脏疾病研究所](https://www.niddk.nih.gov/health-information/endocrine-diseases/primary-hyperparathyroidism)。
etymology_story.en: This modern medical formation combines Greek-derived hyper-, 'excessive', parathyroid, naming glands near the thyroid, and -ism, marking a condition. It describes excessive parathyroid hormone production, while para-, 'beside', identifies the glands by location. For the medical meaning, see [NIDDK](https://www.niddk.nih.gov/health-information/endocrine-diseases/primary-hyperparathyroidism).

morphology_enriched.zh: hyper-（过度）+ parathyroid（甲状旁腺）+ -ism（状态、病症）→ hyperparathyroidism；parathyroid 可进一步分析为 para-（在旁边）+ thyroid（甲状腺）。主要相关词族：parathyroid（甲状旁腺；甲状旁腺的），parathyroidal（甲状旁腺的），hyperparathyroid（甲状旁腺功能亢进的），hypoparathyroidism（甲状旁腺功能减退症），hypoparathyroid（甲状旁腺功能减退的），parathyroidectomy（甲状旁腺切除术）。该病名通常不使用复数。
morphology_enriched.en: Hyper- ('excessive') + parathyroid ('parathyroid gland') + -ism ('condition') → hyperparathyroidism; parathyroid further divides into para- ('beside') + thyroid. Principal related forms are parathyroid, a noun and adjective; parathyroidal, an adjective; hyperparathyroid, describing the overactive condition; hypoparathyroidism and hypoparathyroid, describing deficient function; and parathyroidectomy, surgical removal of parathyroid tissue. The condition noun is normally uncountable.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: parathyroid overactivity（甲状旁腺过度活跃）是通俗解释；excessive PTH secretion（甲状旁腺激素分泌过多）突出其生理机制；hyperparathyroid disease（甲状旁腺功能亢进性疾病）是相近的临床表达。这些主要是释义性近义表达，而非意义范围完全相同的独立病名。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Parathyroid overactivity is a plain-language explanation; excessive PTH secretion emphasizes the physiological mechanism; hyperparathyroid disease is a closely related clinical expression. These are explanatory near-equivalents rather than separate disease names with perfectly identical scope.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: hyper-＝过度，para-＝在旁边：甲状腺“旁边”的腺体分泌过度。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Hyper- means too much; para- means beside: the glands beside the thyroid produce too much hormone.

etymology_story.zh: jitney 在19世纪末的美国俚语中指五美分硬币，其更早来源尚不确定。20世纪初，它因五美分的车费而转指廉价载客汽车，后来又用于小巴和某些地区的无牌出租车。参见 [《韦氏词典》](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/jitney)。
etymology_story.en: Jitney meant a five-cent coin in late nineteenth-century American slang, but its earlier origin is uncertain. In the early twentieth century, the five-cent fare gave its name to inexpensive passenger vehicles, later including small buses and, regionally, unlicensed taxis. See [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/jitney).

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 jitney 是不可进一步作可靠词缀分析的完整词基；复数为 jitneys。历史性派生词 jitneyist 指经营或驾驶此类车辆的人，现较罕见；jeepney（菲律宾吉普式客运车）是 jeep + jitney 构成的混成词。常见组合有 jitney driver（小巴或无牌出租车司机）、jitney service（小巴客运服务）。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, jitney is a whole base with no reliable productive affix breakdown; its plural is jitneys. The historical derivative jitneyist means an operator or driver of such vehicles and is now rare; jeepney, a Philippine passenger vehicle, blends jeep and jitney. Common combinations include jitney driver and jitney service.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: minibus（小型公共汽车）主要说明车辆大小；share taxi（合乘出租车）强调不同乘客共同乘坐并付费；shuttle（接驳车）强调在指定地点之间往返。jitney 带有美国或地区用语色彩，可与其中某一类重合，但不必同时具备三者特征。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Minibus primarily describes vehicle size; share taxi emphasizes unrelated passengers sharing a paid ride; shuttle emphasizes repeated transport between designated places. Jitney is American or regional vocabulary that can overlap with these categories without necessarily combining all their features.

etymology_story.zh: 英语在19世纪从南非荷兰语的旧形式 lager 借入此词；该形式来自德语 Lager（营地），南非荷兰语今作 laer。它最初表示营地，尤其是车辆围护的营地，后来引申为群体封闭防御的立场或心态。参见 [《韦氏词典》](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/laager)。
etymology_story.en: English borrowed the word in the nineteenth century from obsolete Afrikaans lager, now laer, derived from German Lager, 'camp'. Its sense of a camp, especially one protected by vehicles, later supplied a metaphor for a group's closed, defensive position or attitude. See [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/laager).

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语把 laager 作为完整词基；名词通过零派生兼作动词，无须添加词缀。形式包括 laagers（名词复数或动词第三人称单数）、laagered（过去式及过去分词）、laagering（现在分词，也可表示围成车阵的行动）；laager up 是动词短语，laager mentality 是固定名词组合。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern English treats laager as a whole base; the noun also functions as a verb through conversion without an added affix. Forms include laagers, the noun plural or third-person singular verb; laagered, the past tense and past participle; and laagering, the present participle, also usable as an action noun. Laager up is a verb phrase, and laager mentality is an established noun combination.

synonyms_and_nuances.en: Encampment names a campsite without requiring a protective vehicle arrangement; wagon circle explicitly describes the arrangement of wagons; defensive posture matches the figurative sense but need not imply the insularity or exclusion suggested by laager.

mnemonic_anchor.en: Vehicles close around a camp; people close ranks around their group: the physical defence becomes a defensive mindset.

etymology_story.zh: momenta 是 momentum 沿用拉丁语形式的复数；拉丁语 momentum 原有“运动、推动力、分量或重要性”等含义，与 movere“移动”有关。英语科学用语将 momentum 专门用于“动量”，并保留了 momenta 这一复数形式。
etymology_story.en: Momenta preserves the Latin plural of momentum, a word associated with movement, impulse, and weight or importance and related to movere, meaning 'to move.' Scientific English specialized momentum as a physical quantity and retained momenta as its learned plural.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代屈折关系：momentum → momenta，即将单数词尾 -um 换为拉丁式复数词尾 -a；这不是添加派生后缀。momentums 也是可见的英语规则复数形式，但物理学通常使用 momenta；相关复合术语有 linear momentum“线动量”和 angular momentum“角动量”。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern inflection: momentum → momenta, replacing singular -um with Latin plural -a; this is inflection, not derivation. The regular English plural momentums also occurs, although physics normally uses momenta; related compounds include linear momentum and angular momentum.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: momenta 与 momentums 是同一名词的两种复数形式，前者更符合物理学惯例；quantities of motion“运动量”是较旧或解释性的近义表达。impulses“冲量”不是同义词：冲量表示动量的变化，而不是动量本身。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Momenta and momentums are alternative plurals of the same noun, with momenta preferred in physics; quantities of motion is an older or explanatory near-equivalent. Impulses are different: an impulse represents a change in momentum, rather than momentum itself.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 一个 momentum，多个 momenta：记住 -um → -a；经典力学中每个动量都是“质量 × 速度”。
mnemonic_anchor.en: One momentum, several momenta: remember -um → -a, with each classical momentum equal to mass × velocity.

etymology.text: 英语以族名 Mongol 接上源自希腊语的 -oid，造出这个旧分类词。它留下了过去按外貌划分人群的语言痕迹。

relations.meaning: 蒙古的；与本课旧分类词不同

usage_note: 本义通常写作 Mongoloid，首字母大写。只在阅读、转述旧分类时识别，不用于现代科学分类或称呼他人；另一个旧医学义现有冒犯性，本课不教。

etymology_story.zh: 该词由 Mongol“蒙古人”与源自希腊语、表示“形似”的 -oid 构成，产生于依据外貌划分人群的旧分类体系。后来，它又因对外貌的错误类比被用于唐氏综合征，相关医学称谓现已废弃。
etymology_story.en: The word combines Mongol with the Greek-derived suffix -oid, meaning 'resembling,' and arose within older systems that classified populations by appearance. It was later applied to Down syndrome through a mistaken comparison of physical features, a medical usage that has since been abandoned.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代可识别结构：Mongol + -oid → Mongoloid；同一形式兼作形容词和名词，小写 mongoloid 常见于旧医学用法。相关词有 Mongol“蒙古人；蒙古的”、Mongolian“蒙古的；蒙古人；蒙古语”，以及已废弃且具有冒犯性的 mongolism“唐氏综合征旧称”；这些相关词并非全部由 Mongoloid 派生。
morphology_enriched.en: Recognizable structure: Mongol + -oid → Mongoloid; the same form functions as an adjective and a noun, with lowercase mongoloid common in obsolete medical usage. Related vocabulary includes Mongol, Mongolian, and the obsolete, offensive term mongolism; these are related forms, not all derivatives of Mongoloid.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: Mongolian“蒙古的；蒙古人”只涉及蒙古的民族、语言或地域，不能替代旧人种分类词。East Asian“东亚的；东亚人”是地域性表达，与旧分类范围不同；person with Down syndrome“唐氏综合征患者”是相关医学名词旧义的尊重性替代表达。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Mongolian concerns Mongolia, its people, or its language and does not replace the obsolete racial category. East Asian is a geographical description with a different scope; person with Down syndrome is a respectful replacement for the obsolete medical noun.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: Mongol + -oid“形似”：记住它记录的是旧时代的外貌类比，不是现代人群分类。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Mongol + -oid, 'resembling': remember an outdated comparison of appearances, rather than a modern classification of people.

morphology.text: myo-（肌肉） + -cyte（细胞）→ myocyte（肌细胞）。

etymology.text: 现代医学用新拉丁语构词成分造词：myo- 追溯到希腊语 mys“肌肉”，-cyte 经新拉丁语追溯到希腊语 kytos“容器”。把肌细胞想成能收缩的小单元。

usage_note: 生物学、医学名词；可说 a cardiac myocyte（心肌细胞）。myocyte 指细胞，muscle 可指肌肉组织或一块肌肉。

etymology_story.zh: myocyte 是由希腊语来源的科学构词成分组成的术语：myo- 来自 mys“肌肉”，-cyte 来自 kytos“中空容器”。后一个成分在现代生物学中获得“细胞”的专门含义，因此全词表示“肌肉细胞”。
etymology_story.en: Myocyte is a scientific formation using Greek-derived elements: myo- comes from mys, meaning 'muscle,' and -cyte from kytos, meaning a hollow vessel. The latter element acquired the specialized biological meaning 'cell,' giving the compound its meaning 'muscle cell.'

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代构词：myo-“肌肉” + -cyte“细胞” → myocyte；复数 myocytes，形容词 myocytic“肌细胞的”。扩展形式包括 cardiomyocyte“心肌细胞”、leiomyocyte“平滑肌细胞”和 rhabdomyocyte“横纹肌细胞”；相关构词 myocytolysis 表示“肌细胞溶解”。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern formation: myo-, 'muscle,' + -cyte, 'cell,' → myocyte; the plural is myocytes and the adjective is myocytic. Extended formations include cardiomyocyte, leiomyocyte, and rhabdomyocyte; the related formation myocytolysis denotes the dissolution or breakdown of muscle cells.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: muscle cell“肌细胞”是直接、通俗的同义表达；muscle fiber“肌纤维”尤其常用于细长的骨骼肌细胞；cardiomyocyte“心肌细胞”只指心脏中的肌细胞，是 myocyte 的下位词。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Muscle cell is the direct plain-language equivalent; muscle fiber is used especially for an elongated skeletal muscle cell. Cardiomyocyte refers specifically to a heart muscle cell and is a subtype of myocyte.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: myo 是肌肉，cyte 是细胞：肌肉中能收缩的基本细胞。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Myo means muscle and cyte means cell: a cell built to contract.

meaning: 纳曲酮（一种阿片受体拮抗药）
aliases: 纳曲酮（一种阿片受体拮抗药）

family: naltrexone hydrochloride 盐酸纳曲酮。

morphology.text: N-allyl（N-烯丙基，缩合为 nal-） + trex- + -one（酮类药名成分）→ naltrexone。它是药物专名，不能按普通生活词硬拆。

etymology.text: 这是现代英语药物命名中的造词：名称组合了 N-allyl、也见于 methotrexate 名称中的 trex- 和 -one。记忆时把整个名称和“纳曲酮”对应。

usage_note: 通用药名通常小写；不是商标，也不要与 naloxone 混作同一药物。这里学习名称和类别。

etymology_story.zh: naltrexone 是二十世纪形成的药物通用名称，命名背景与合成阿片拮抗药的发展有关。它不是由普通英语词素透明组合而成的词，不能把某种未经证实的逐段拆解当作确定词源。
etymology_story.en: Naltrexone is a twentieth-century generic drug name associated with the development of synthetic opioid antagonists. Its name is not a transparent combination of ordinary English morphemes, so an unverified segment-by-segment explanation should not be treated as established etymology.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中宜将 naltrexone 作为完整药名识记；词尾 -one 与分子中的酮基相呼应，但 nal-、-trex- 不能按普通能产词缀解释。将其解释为 N-allyl“氮上烯丙基”的直接组合并不合适，因为纳曲酮具有 N-环丙基甲基取代基；相关名称有 naltrexone hydrochloride“盐酸纳曲酮”和代谢物 6β-naltrexol“6β-纳曲醇”，后者不是普通英语派生词。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, naltrexone is best learned as a complete drug name; final -one is consistent with its ketone group, but nal- and -trex- are not ordinary productive affixes. A direct N-allyl analysis is inappropriate because naltrexone has an N-cyclopropylmethyl substituent; related names include naltrexone hydrochloride and the metabolite 6β-naltrexol, which is a chemical name rather than an ordinary English derivative.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: opioid antagonist“阿片受体拮抗药”是药物类别名称，范围比 naltrexone 大；naltrexone hydrochloride“盐酸纳曲酮”特指其盐酸盐形式；naloxone“纳洛酮”是另一种相关药物，不能作为 naltrexone 的同义词。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Opioid antagonist names the broader drug class; naltrexone hydrochloride specifies its hydrochloride salt. Naloxone is a related but different medicine and is not a synonym for naltrexone.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 整体对应“纳曲酮”，核心联系是“阻断阿片受体”；不要用虚构词根硬拆药名。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Learn naltrexone as one name and connect it with blocking opioid receptors; avoid inventing roots to explain the drug name.

etymology.text: 英语从印地语、乌尔都语 nīm 借入，继续可追溯到梵语 nimba。这是随南亚树木知识一起进入英语的名称。

usage_note: 树名通常小写。neem 指树，也常放在 oil、seed、leaf 前说明来源。不要把树名直接当成所有产品的名称。

senses.meaning_zh: 印楝；印楝树；印楝原料或制品
senses.meaning_en: the tree Azadirachta indica, or material or preparations obtained from it
senses.english_definition: A neem is a tropical tree whose seeds, leaves, and other parts are used to make oils and other products; neem can also mean material or preparations obtained from this tree.

senses.collocation_zh: 印楝树；印楝油
senses.sentence_en: A mature neem tree shaded the courtyard, and bottles of neem oil stood on a nearby shelf.
senses.sentence_zh: 一棵成年的印楝树为庭院遮阴，旁边的架子上摆着几瓶印楝油。

etymology_story.zh: 英语 neem 借自印地语、乌尔都语的 nīm，可进一步追溯到梵语 nimba。这个南亚树名随有关当地植物及其用途的知识进入英语，后来也用于指由该树制成的原料或制品。
etymology_story.en: English borrowed neem from Hindi and Urdu nīm, ultimately tracing back to Sanskrit nimba. The South Asian tree name entered English with knowledge of the plant and its uses, and it also came to denote materials or preparations obtained from the tree.

morphology_enriched.zh: neem 是现代英语中不可再透明拆分的借入词；指多棵树时复数可用 neems，指原料时通常不可数。它主要通过复合构词扩展：neem tree“印楝树”、neem oil“印楝油”、neem seed“印楝种子”、neem cake“印楝籽饼”和 neem-based“以印楝为原料的”；没有常用的标准动词或独立形容词派生形式。
morphology_enriched.en: Neem is a borrowed word without a transparent internal breakdown in modern English; neems can refer to multiple trees, while material uses are normally uncountable. Its main extensions are compounds: neem tree, neem oil, neem seed, neem cake, and neem-based; it has no common standard verb or independently derived adjective.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: nim 是 neem 的异体拼写；margosa 是指这种树的另一英语名称；Azadirachta indica 是其精确的植物学名称。chinaberry 通常指另一物种 Melia azedarach“苦楝”，不宜当作严格同义词。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Nim is a variant spelling of neem; margosa is another English name for the tree; Azadirachta indica is its precise botanical name. Chinaberry usually refers to the different species Melia azedarach and should not be treated as an exact synonym.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 把 neem 与“印楝树 → 印楝油”连起来：树名可自然延伸为原料名。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Link neem tree → neem oil: the tree's name naturally extends to materials obtained from it.

morphology.text: nephro-（肾） + -logy（学科）→ nephrology（肾脏病学）。

etymology.text: 英语用源自希腊语 nephros“肾”的 nephro- 和表示学科的 -logy 造词，十九世纪已用来指研究肾脏的医学分支。

sentence: She chose nephrology because she wanted to study kidney disease.
translation: 她选择肾脏病学，因为她想研究肾脏疾病。
scenario: 了解医学生选择的专科。
cloze: She chose _____ because she wanted to study kidney disease.
collocation:
a nephrology clinic 肾脏专科门诊（就诊）
research in nephrology 肾脏病学研究（学术工作）
context_hint: Focus on the organs mentioned after study.
hint: Focus on the organs mentioned after study.

teaching.contrast: nephrology 研究肾脏；neurology 研究神经系统，不能只看相似拼写。
teaching.sentence: The conference has a session on advances in nephrology.
teaching.translation: 这次会议设有一个讨论肾脏病学进展的单元。

comprehension_check.question: 句中 nephrology 表示什么？请选择。
comprehension_check.wrong_reason: kidneys 指肾，确定这里是肾脏病学。

fields.label: 句中目标词表示（肾脏病学／神经病学）
fields.wrong_reason: kidneys 指肾，确定这里是肾脏病学。

senses.meaning_zh: 肾脏病学；研究肾脏功能及肾脏疾病的医学分支
senses.meaning_en: The branch of medicine concerned with kidney function and kidney diseases.
senses.english_definition: Nephrology is the branch of medicine that studies how the kidneys work and how to diagnose and treat kidney diseases.
senses.collocation_en: clinical nephrology; a nephrology department
senses.collocation_zh: 临床肾脏病学；肾内科
senses.sentence_en: She chose to specialize in nephrology after treating patients with kidney disease.
senses.sentence_zh: 在治疗过肾病患者后，她选择专攻肾脏病学。

etymology_story.zh: 这个医学术语由源自希腊语 nephros“肾”的 nephro- 和表示“研究、学科”的 -logy 构成。它在十九世纪的医学英语中已经出现，后来成为研究肾功能及肾病诊疗的专科名称。
etymology_story.en: This medical term combines nephro-, from Greek nephros meaning 'kidney,' with -logy, meaning 'study.' It was already used in nineteenth-century medical English and became the name of the specialty concerned with kidney function and kidney disease.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代构词：nephro-（肾）+ -logy（研究、学科）。主要词族：nephrologist（肾脏病学专家、肾内科医生），nephrological、nephrologic（肾脏病学的）；nephritis（肾炎）和 nephropathy（肾病）是共享 nephro-/nephr- 词根的相关词，并非由 nephrology 直接派生。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern structure: nephro- ('kidney') + -logy ('study or discipline'). Principal family members are nephrologist ('a kidney specialist') and nephrological or nephrologic ('relating to nephrology'). Nephritis ('kidney inflammation') and nephropathy ('kidney disease') share the nephro-/nephr- root but are not direct derivatives of nephrology.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: renal medicine（肾脏医学）是常用近义名称；kidney medicine（肾脏医学）更通俗。urology（泌尿外科学）是相关专科，侧重泌尿系统及男性生殖系统，尤其涉及外科治疗，不能与 nephrology 完全互换。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Renal medicine is a common equivalent; kidney medicine is a plainer expression. Urology is a related specialty covering the urinary system and male reproductive system, especially surgical care, so it is not interchangeable with nephrology.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: nephro- 是“肾”，-logy 是“学科”：研究肾脏的医学。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Nephro- means 'kidney' and -logy means 'study': the medical study of kidneys.

meaning: 海苔（常压成薄片的食用紫菜）
aliases: 海苔（常压成薄片的食用紫菜）

pronunciation.note: 采用美式读音；ˈ 标主重音，ˌ 标次重音。

forms: 通常不可数；一片用 a sheet of nori，多片用 sheets of nori。
family: nori-wrapped 用海苔包裹的；nori sheet 海苔片。

morphology.text: nori 作为独立词素记忆；nori + wrapped → nori-wrapped（用海苔包裹的），是食材名与分词构成的复合形容词。

etymology.text: 英语直接借用日语 nori“海苔”。把寿司外面那层薄薄的海苔和这个日语借词连在一起记。

usage_note: 通常小写。nori 指食材；sheet of nori 才表示一片。并非所有海藻都叫 nori。

sources.label: BNC/COCA 词条身份、词族与顺序

sentence: Wrap the rice in a sheet of nori.
translation: 把米饭裹进一片海苔里。
scenario: 在厨房制作饭卷。

nori for sushi rolls 做寿司卷用的海苔（包裹食材）
nori strips on noodles 面条上的海苔丝（撒料调味）
context_hint: Think about the thin seaweed wrapper around the rice.
hint: Think about the thin seaweed wrapper around the rice.

teaching.sentence: She sprinkled strips of nori over the noodles.

senses.meaning_zh: 海苔；通常干制并压成薄片的食用紫菜
senses.meaning_en: Edible red seaweed, usually dried and pressed into thin sheets.
senses.english_definition: Nori is a type of edible seaweed that is usually dried into thin sheets and used to wrap sushi or garnish food.
senses.collocation_en: nori sheets; toasted nori
senses.collocation_zh: 海苔片；烤海苔
senses.sentence_en: Place the rice on a sheet of nori and add the filling.
senses.sentence_zh: 把米饭铺在一张海苔上，再放上馅料。

etymology_story.zh: 英语直接借用日语 nori（海苔），用来指这种食用海藻及其加工食品。随着日本料理传播，英语中这个词尤其让人联想到包寿司用的干海苔片。
etymology_story.en: English borrowed nori directly from Japanese, where it names edible seaweed and preparations made from it. As Japanese cuisine spread, the English word became especially associated with dried sheets used to wrap sushi.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 nori 是不可进一步拆分的借词，没有常用的前后缀派生词族。常见组合包括 nori sheet（海苔片）、nori flakes（海苔碎）；nori-wrapped（用海苔包裹的）和 nori-flavoured（海苔风味的）是可按需组成的复合形容词，并非独立词根衍生词。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, nori is an unanalyzed loanword with no common affix-derived word family. Common combinations include nori sheet and nori flakes. Nori-wrapped and nori-flavoured are freely formed compound adjectives, rather than derivatives built from an English root.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: laver（紫菜）是最接近的相关名称，但可指未经制成海苔片的食用红藻；seaweed（海藻）范围更广，也包括不可食用品种；edible seaweed（食用海藻）强调可食用性，但不特指 nori。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Laver is the closest related term, but it can refer to edible red seaweed before it is made into sheets. Seaweed is much broader and includes inedible varieties; edible seaweed specifies food use without identifying nori in particular.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 把 nori 与寿司外面那张薄薄的海苔直接绑定记忆。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Picture the thin seaweed sheet around a sushi roll: that is nori.

pronunciation.note: 采用美式读音；ˈ 标主重音，ˌ 标次重音。

forms: 形容词，无时态或复数变化。
family: otology 耳科学；otitis 耳炎。

morphology.text: ot-（耳） + -ic（……的）→ otic（耳的）。

etymology.text: 来自希腊语 ōtikos“耳的”，其中 ōt- 是 ous“耳”的词干。抓住“耳”这个身体部位就能记住。

usage_note: 医学用语，常修饰耳部结构或制剂。不要和 optic（视觉的）混淆；otic 作为完整形容词也不同于某些词末的 -otic 后缀。

sources.label: BNC/COCA 词条身份、词族与顺序

sentence: The diagram labels the otic capsule near the inner ear.
translation: 图中标出了内耳附近的耳囊。
scenario: 辨认解剖图中的耳部结构。
cloze: The diagram labels the _____ capsule near the inner ear.
collocation:
the otic capsule 耳囊（解剖结构）
an otic preparation 耳用制剂（药品标签）
context_hint: The inner ear tells you which body region is involved.
hint: The inner ear tells you which body region is involved.

teaching.contrast: otic 与耳有关；optic 与眼或视觉有关，差一个 p，部位却不同。
teaching.sentence: The bottle is marked for otic use.
teaching.translation: 瓶上标着供耳部使用。

comprehension_check.sentence: The label says otic use, meaning use in the ear.
comprehension_check.question: 句中 otic 表示什么？请选择。
comprehension_check.wrong_reason: in the ear 直接指出使用部位是耳部。

fields.label: 句中目标词表示（耳部的／眼部的）
fields.wrong_reason: in the ear 直接指出使用部位是耳部。

senses.meaning_zh: 耳的；与耳有关的；用于耳部的
senses.meaning_en: Relating to the ear or intended for use in the ear.
senses.english_definition: Something that is otic is connected with the ear or is intended to be used in the ear.
senses.collocation_en: otic drops; an otic solution
senses.collocation_zh: 滴耳液；耳用溶液
senses.sentence_en: The bottle was labelled as an otic solution.
senses.sentence_zh: 瓶身标签注明这是一种耳用溶液。

etymology_story.zh: otic 源于希腊语 ōtikos“耳的”，其词干 ōt- 来自 ous“耳”的屈折形式。英语保留了这一解剖学含义，主要用于医学、药学和生物学语境。
etymology_story.en: Otic derives from Greek ōtikos, meaning 'of the ear'; its stem ōt- comes from an inflected form of ous, 'ear.' English preserves this anatomical meaning, chiefly in medicine, pharmacy, and biology.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代分析：ot-（耳的黏着词根）+ -ic（……的）。没有常用的直接派生词族；同根相关词有 otology（耳科学）、otologist（耳科专家）、otological（耳科学的）、otitis（耳炎）、otoscope（耳镜）、otoscopy（耳镜检查）、ototoxic（耳毒性的）和 ototoxicity（耳毒性）。其中 oto- 是该词根的常见组合形式。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern analysis: ot- (the bound root meaning 'ear') + -ic ('relating to'). There is no common directly derived family. Related words sharing the root include otology, otologist, otological, otitis, otoscope, otoscopy, ototoxic, and ototoxicity. Oto- is the root's usual combining form in compounds.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: aural（耳的；听觉的）既可指耳，也常强调听觉体验；auricular（耳的；耳廓的）在解剖语境中可更具体地指耳廓；auditory（听觉的）侧重听觉功能及其神经通路。otic 主要是医学上表示“与耳有关或供耳部使用”的用语。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Aural can refer to the ear but often emphasizes hearing or listening. Auricular can refer more specifically to the external ear in anatomical contexts. Auditory focuses on hearing and its pathways, whereas otic is chiefly a medical term for relation to, or use in, the ear.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 把 ot- 与 otitis“耳炎”中的“耳”连起来：otic 就是“耳的”。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Connect ot- with the ear in otitis: otic simply means 'of the ear.'

meaning: 光刻（借助光转移图案的工艺）
aliases: 光刻（借助光转移图案的工艺）

pronunciation.note: 采用美式读音；ˈ 标主重音，ˌ 标次重音。

forms: 工艺名通常不可数；photolithographic 是形容词，photolithographically 是副词。
family: photolithograph 光刻图版；photolithographic 光刻的。

morphology.text: photo-（光） + litho-（石） + -graphy（刻写、记录工艺）→ photolithography。现代光刻可把图案转移到芯片等表面。

etymology.text: 这是以希腊语来源的“光、石、刻写”成分组合的国际科技词。它最初与照相制版的石印工艺有关，后来也用于电子制造中的光刻。

usage_note: 本课取电子及微细加工中的光刻义。photolithography 是转移图案的工艺，etching 是蚀刻，不能把两步简单等同。

sources.label: BNC/COCA 词条身份、词族与顺序

sentence: The factory uses photolithography to pattern silicon wafers.

collocation:
photolithography for chip production 芯片生产中的光刻
photolithography for microfluidic channels 微流体通道制作中的光刻
context_hint: Light transfers a pattern onto the wafer.
hint: Light transfers a pattern onto the wafer.

teaching.contrast: photolithography 形成图案；后续蚀刻可能沿图案去除材料，两者有联系但不是同一步。
teaching.sentence: The lab used photolithography to make tiny channels for a fluid experiment.
teaching.translation: 实验室用光刻工艺制作了流体实验所需的微小通道。

comprehension_check.wrong_reason: mask 控制 light，指通过光来转移图案的工艺。

fields.label: 句中目标词表示（用光转移图案的工艺／用机械刀具切割的工艺）
fields.wrong_reason: mask 控制 light，指通过光来转移图案的工艺。

senses.meaning_zh: 光刻；利用光将图案转移到感光材料上的微细加工工艺
senses.meaning_en: A process that uses light to transfer patterns onto a light-sensitive material, especially in microelectronics.
senses.english_definition: Photolithography is a process in which light forms a pattern in a light-sensitive coating so that very small structures can be made.
senses.collocation_en: semiconductor photolithography; a photolithography process
senses.collocation_zh: 半导体光刻；光刻工艺
senses.sentence_en: Photolithography defines tiny patterns on the silicon wafer.
senses.sentence_zh: 光刻在硅晶圆上形成微小的图案。

senses.meaning_zh: 照相平版印刷术；利用摄影方法制作石印或平版印刷版的技术
senses.meaning_en: Lithographic printing in which photographic methods are used to prepare the printing surface.
senses.english_definition: Photolithography is a method of preparing a lithographic printing surface by transferring an image photographically.
senses.collocation_en: photolithographic printing; reproduction by photolithography
senses.collocation_zh: 照相平版印刷；通过照相平版印刷复制
senses.sentence_en: The publisher used photolithography to reproduce the original map.
senses.sentence_zh: 出版商采用照相平版印刷术复制了原始地图。

etymology_story.zh: 这个词由 photo-“光”与 lithography“石版印刷术”组合而成，后者包含源自希腊语的“石”和“书写”成分。它最初指利用摄影方法制作平版印刷图像的技术，后来扩展到电子制造中借助光转移微细图案的工艺。
etymology_story.en: The word combines photo-, meaning 'light,' with lithography, whose Greek elements mean 'stone' and 'writing.' It first referred to photographic methods used in lithographic printing and later extended to transferring fine patterns with light in electronics manufacturing.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代构词：photo-（光）+ lithography（平版印刷术）；进一步分析为 photo- + litho-（石）+ -graphy（书写、记录或相关工艺）。主要词族：photolithographic（光刻的；照相平版印刷的）、photolithographically（通过光刻或照相平版印刷）、photolithograph（照相平版印刷品；以该法印制）和 photolithographer（照相平版印刷从业者）。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern structure: photo- ('light') + lithography; further analysis gives photo- + litho- ('stone') + -graphy ('writing, recording, or a related process'). Principal family members are photolithographic, photolithographically, photolithograph (a print, or to produce one by this method), and photolithographer.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: optical lithography（光学光刻）在半导体语境中常与其近义；lithography（平版印刷；微影加工）范围更广，也可包括电子束等非光学技术；photoengraving（照相制版、照相雕刻）是相关技术，但常涉及通过蚀刻形成印刷表面，不能在所有语境中替换 photolithography。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Optical lithography is a common near-equivalent in semiconductor contexts. Lithography is broader and can include non-optical techniques such as electron-beam lithography. Photoengraving is related but often involves etching a printing surface, so it is not universally interchangeable with photolithography.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: photo 是“光”，lithography 是“制版”：用光把图案搬到表面上。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Photo means 'light': picture light transferring a pattern onto a surface.

meaning: 多价的（针对多种抗原、毒素等的）
aliases: 多价的（针对多种抗原、毒素等的）

pronunciation.note: 采用美式读音；ˈ 标主重音，ˌ 标次重音。

forms: 形容词，无复数或时态变化；名词 polyvalence。
family: polyvalence 多价性；monovalent 单价的。

morphology.text: poly-（多） + valent（有价、有效力的）→ polyvalent（多价的）。

etymology.text: 这是国际科技词，以希腊语来源的 poly-“多”和拉丁语 valere“有力”所衍生的 valent 组合而成；“多重效力”可帮助记住免疫学用法。

usage_note: 本课是免疫学义：针对不止一种相关目标。化学中也有多价义，但不能把免疫学中的“价”理解为价格。

sources.label: BNC/COCA 词条身份、词族与顺序

sentence: The report describes a polyvalent vaccine targeting several strains.
translation: 报告介绍了一种针对多个毒株的多价疫苗。
scenario: 阅读疫苗研究报告。
cloze: The report describes a _____ vaccine targeting several strains.
collocation:
a polyvalent vaccine 多价疫苗（预防接种）
polyvalent antivenom 多价抗蛇毒血清（蛇伤急救）
context_hint: Several strains are listed as targets.
hint: Several strains are listed as targets.

teaching.contrast: polyvalent 强调多个免疫目标；monovalent 强调一个目标，都不描述价格高低。
teaching.sentence: The emergency unit keeps a polyvalent antivenom for several snake species.
teaching.translation: 急救部门备有针对几种蛇的多价抗蛇毒血清。

comprehension_check.sentence: This polyvalent serum acts against more than one toxin.
comprehension_check.question: 句中 polyvalent 表示什么？请选择。
comprehension_check.wrong_reason: more than one toxin 说明作用目标不止一种。

fields.label: 句中目标词表示（针对多种毒素的／只针对一种毒素的）
fields.wrong_reason: more than one toxin 说明作用目标不止一种。

senses.meaning_zh: 多价的；具有大于一的化合价或可表现多种化合价的
senses.meaning_en: Having a valency greater than one, or capable of exhibiting more than one valency.
senses.english_definition: In chemistry, a polyvalent atom or element has a combining capacity greater than one or can have different combining capacities.
senses.collocation_en: polyvalent ions; polyvalent metals
senses.collocation_zh: 多价离子；多价金属
senses.sentence_en: Polyvalent metal ions can bind to several sites on the polymer.
senses.sentence_zh: 多价金属离子可以与聚合物上的多个位点结合。

senses.meaning_zh: 多价的；能针对多种抗原、病原体型别或毒素发挥作用的
senses.meaning_en: Effective against several antigens, pathogen types, or toxins.
senses.english_definition: A polyvalent vaccine or antiserum is designed to act against several types of a pathogen, antigen, or toxin.
senses.collocation_en: a polyvalent vaccine; polyvalent antivenom
senses.collocation_zh: 多价疫苗；多价抗蛇毒血清
senses.sentence_en: The laboratory developed a polyvalent vaccine containing antigens from several strains.
senses.sentence_zh: 该实验室研制了一种含有多个菌株抗原的多价疫苗。

senses.meaning_zh: 多功能的；具有多重意义或多方面价值的
senses.meaning_en: Having several functions, meanings, or kinds of value.
senses.english_definition: Something that is polyvalent can serve several purposes or carry several meanings.
senses.collocation_en: a polyvalent symbol; polyvalent meanings
senses.collocation_zh: 具有多重意义的象征；多重含义
senses.sentence_en: Fire is a polyvalent symbol in the poem, suggesting both destruction and renewal.
senses.sentence_zh: 火在这首诗中是一个具有多重意义的象征，既暗示毁灭，也暗示新生。

etymology_story.zh: 这个科学词结合了希腊语来源的 poly-“多”和拉丁语 valere“强健、有力量”相关的 valent，后者在化学中表示结合能力或化合价。它从“具有多重结合能力”的化学含义扩展到免疫学中的多重针对性，也用于表示多功能或多重意义。
etymology_story.en: This scientific word combines Greek-derived poly-, meaning 'many,' with valent, ultimately related to Latin valere, 'to be strong,' and used in chemistry for combining capacity. Its chemical meaning extended to multiple immune targets and, more broadly, to multiple functions or meanings.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代构词：poly-（多）+ -valent（具有某种价或结合能力的）。主要直接词族：polyvalence、polyvalency（多价性；多功能性或多义性）。相关构词有 monovalent（一价的）、bivalent（二价的）、trivalent（三价的）和 multivalent（多价的；多重的）；它们是同构相关词，并非由 polyvalent 直接派生。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern structure: poly- ('many') + -valent ('having a specified valency or combining capacity'). Principal direct family members are polyvalence and polyvalency. Related formations include monovalent, bivalent, trivalent, and multivalent; these are parallel formations rather than derivatives of polyvalent.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: multivalent（多价的；多重的）在化学和免疫学中常与 polyvalent 近义，但具体适用范围取决于领域；versatile（多才多艺的；多用途的）强调适应不同任务的能力；multifunctional（多功能的）强调具有多个实际功能，通常不表示多重象征意义。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Multivalent is often a close equivalent in chemistry and immunology, though usage depends on the field. Versatile emphasizes adaptability across tasks; multifunctional emphasizes several practical functions and usually does not imply multiple symbolic meanings.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: poly- 是“多”，-valent 是“结合能力”：能多处结合、针对多种目标，进而具有多种用途或意义。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Poly- means 'many' and -valent suggests combining capacity: many connections, many targets, or many meanings.

pronunciation.note: 采用美式读音；ˈ 标主重音，ˌ 标次重音。

forms: 单数 saurian；复数 saurians；也有形容词用法，本课只教名词。
family: saurian 蜥蜴类的（形容词）；dinosaur 恐龙。

morphology.text: saur-（蜥蜴） + -ian（某一类的成员）→ saurian（蜥蜴类爬行动物）。

etymology.text: 由新拉丁语分类名 Sauria 而来，其 saurus 可追溯到希腊语 sauros“蜥蜴”。看到 saur-，可联想到蜥蜴形的爬行动物。

usage_note: 较专业的动物学词；历史分类的覆盖范围比现代分类宽。本课在明确指蜥蜴的语境中学习，不把它当作所有爬行动物的统称。

senses.english_definition: Something that is saurian is connected with lizards or resembles a lizard.

senses.sentence_zh: 这种生物覆有鳞片的皮肤使它看起来像蜥蜴。

etymology_story.zh: 该词以新拉丁语分类名称 Sauria 为基础，最终源于希腊语 sauros，意为“蜥蜴”。它既可指蜥蜴或蜥蜴状爬行动物，也可作形容词表示与蜥蜴有关或形似蜥蜴。
etymology_story.en: The word is based on the New Latin taxonomic name Sauria, ultimately from Greek sauros, meaning 'lizard.' It developed both noun uses for lizards or lizardlike reptiles and adjective uses describing their characteristics.

morphology_enriched.zh: 可按 saur-（蜥蜴这一学术词根）+ -ian（属于……的；……类成员）理解；普通现代英语中通常把全词作为一个单位使用。名词复数为 saurians；同源构词成分见 -saur、-saurus 和 dinosaur（恐龙），这些不是由 saurian 直接派生的。
morphology_enriched.en: The learned structure is saur- ('lizard') + -ian ('relating to' or 'a member of'); ordinary modern usage generally treats the word as a unit. The noun plural is saurians; related formations include -saur, -saurus, and dinosaur, which are not direct derivatives of saurian.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: lizard（蜥蜴）是日常用词，指具体动物类群；reptile（爬行动物）范围更广；lizardlike（像蜥蜴的）只描述相似外形。saurian 较为学术或文学化，其具体范围取决于语境。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Lizard is the everyday term for the animal group; reptile is broader; lizardlike describes resemblance without implying classification. Saurian is more scholarly or literary, and its precise scope depends on context.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 抓住 saur- 的“蜥蜴”意象：名词是蜥蜴类动物，形容词是“蜥蜴般的”。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Anchor saur- to 'lizard': the noun names the creature, and the adjective describes its lizardlike qualities.

pronunciation.note: 采用美式读音；ˈ 标主重音，ˌ 标次重音。

forms: 表示相似性时常不可数；表示相似之处时可数，复数 similitudes。
family: similar 相似的；similarity 相似性。

morphology.text: simil-（相似） + -itude（性质、状态）→ similitude（相似性）。

etymology.text: 经盎格鲁法语和拉丁语进入中古英语，源头是拉丁语 similitudo“相似”，来自 similis“相似的”。可和常见词 similar 一起记。

usage_note: 正式、偏书面，常见 similitude between A and B。日常通常说 similarity；本课不教“比喻、譬喻”义。

senses.pos: n. 名词（正式；可数或不可数）
senses.meaning_zh: 相似；相似性；相似之处
senses.meaning_en: resemblance or a point of similarity
senses.english_definition: Similitude is a likeness between people or things, or a particular way in which they are alike.
senses.collocation_en: a striking similitude; similitude between two things
senses.collocation_zh: 显著的相似性；两事物之间的相似性

senses.sentence_zh: 这位评论家指出，两份叙述之间存在显著的相似之处。

senses.meaning_zh: 比喻；类比；寓意性故事
senses.meaning_en: an illustrative comparison or allegorical story
senses.english_definition: A similitude is a comparison or story that explains something by showing how it resembles something else.
senses.collocation_en: a biblical similitude; speak in similitudes
senses.collocation_zh: 《圣经》中的比喻；用比喻说话

etymology_story.zh: 该词经法语进入中古英语，源于拉丁语 similitudo（相似），而后者来自 similis（相似的）。从“相似关系”又发展出“通过相似关系作出的比喻或说明”这一含义。
etymology_story.en: The word entered Middle English through French from Latin similitudo, 'likeness,' derived from similis, 'like.' The idea of resemblance also developed into the sense of a comparison or story used to explain something.

morphology_enriched.zh: 可作学术性分析：simil-（相似）+ -itude（性质或状态）；现代英语中通常把 similitude 当作完整词汇，而不是临时拼合的派生词。复数为 similitudes；同源词族包括 similar（相似的）、similarly（相似地）、similarity（相似性）、dissimilar（不相似的）和 dissimilarity（差异）。
morphology_enriched.en: A learned analysis is simil- ('like') + -itude ('quality or state'); modern English normally treats similitude as an established whole word. Its plural is similitudes; its related family includes similar, similarly, similarity, dissimilar, and dissimilarity.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: similarity（相似性）最中性、最常用；resemblance（相像）常突出外貌或可感知特征；analogy（类比）强调用对应关系进行解释或推理。similitude 语体更正式，且可兼指相似本身与表达相似的比喻。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Similarity is the most neutral everyday term; resemblance often highlights appearance or other perceptible features; analogy emphasizes a comparison used for explanation or reasoning. Similitude is more formal and can name either the likeness itself or an illustrative comparison.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 把 simil- 与 similar 相连：similitude 就是“相似这一状态”，也可指借相似来说明的比喻。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Connect simil- with similar: similitude names the state of being alike, or a comparison built on that likeness.

meaning: 拘谨守旧的；过分拘泥礼法的

pronunciation.note: 采用美式读音；ˈ 标主重音，ˌ 标次重音。

forms: 也拼 straightlaced；比较程度通常用 more / most straitlaced。
family: straitlacedness 拘谨守旧；straitlacedly 拘谨守旧地。

morphology.text: strait（紧的、窄的） + lace（系带） + -ed → straitlaced。由“紧紧束住”联想行为受到严厉规矩约束。

etymology.text: 英语中由 strait“紧、窄”和 laced“系紧带子的”构成，字面指束带紧紧系住，后来形容礼法观念过于拘谨的人。

usage_note: 常带批评色彩，指对行为或道德过分严苛，不只是安静、害羞。straightlaced 是另一拼写。

senses.meaning_zh: 拘谨守旧的；严格拘泥于道德礼法的
senses.meaning_en: very strict about conventional morality and proper behavior
senses.english_definition: Someone who is straitlaced has strict ideas about moral behavior and disapproves of conduct they consider improper.
senses.collocation_en: straitlaced parents; a straitlaced upbringing
senses.collocation_zh: 拘谨守旧的父母；严守礼法的家庭教育
senses.sentence_en: Her straitlaced parents disapproved of her staying out late.
senses.sentence_zh: 她那拘谨守旧的父母不赞成她在外待到很晚。

etymology_story.zh: 该词由 strait（紧的、狭窄的）与 laced（用带子系住的）组成，原本描写衣物束带系得很紧。后来，这种身体受束缚的形象被用来形容思想和行为受到严格道德礼法约束。
etymology_story.en: The word combines strait, meaning 'tight' or 'narrow,' with laced, originally describing tightly fastened clothing. Physical restriction became a metaphor for strict adherence to conventional morality and behavior.

morphology_enriched.zh: 构词公式为 strait（紧的）+ lace（系带）+ -ed，形成复合形容词；这里的 strait 不是 straight（直的）。常见拼写还有 strait-laced；派生名词为 straitlacedness 或 strait-lacedness（拘谨守旧）。
morphology_enriched.en: The structure is strait ('tight') + lace + -ed, forming a compound adjective; strait here is distinct from straight. Strait-laced is a common spelling variant, and the derived noun is straitlacedness or strait-lacedness.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: prim（过分端庄的）偏重拘谨的仪态和举止；prudish（过分避讳性话题的）尤其强调对性或裸露的反感；puritanical（清教徒式严苛的）强调对享乐和道德问题的严厉态度。straitlaced 通常泛指严守传统礼法。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Prim emphasizes stiffly proper manners; prudish especially concerns discomfort with sex or nudity; puritanical suggests harsh moral standards and disapproval of pleasure. Straitlaced more broadly describes rigid adherence to conventional propriety.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 束带系得紧，行为也束得紧：从“紧束衣带”记到“严守礼法”。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Tightly tied laces suggest tightly controlled behavior: physical restraint becomes moral restraint.

meaning: 烧垦地（清除并焚烧植被后暂时耕种的土地）
aliases: 烧垦地（清除并焚烧植被后暂时耕种的土地）

pronunciation.note: 采用美式读音；ˈ 标主重音，ˌ 标次重音。

forms: 单数 swidden；复数 swiddens；也可放在 farming 等词前作修饰。
family: swiddener 烧垦耕作者；swidden farming 烧垦农业。

morphology.text: swidden 作为独立词素记忆；swidden + -er → swiddener（从事烧垦耕作的人）。

etymology.text: 来自英语方言中表示“烧出来的空地”的词；词典认为它很可能与古诺尔斯语 svithinn“烧过的”有关。用“烧出一块耕地”的画面记忆。

usage_note: 人类学、农业及生态学用语。指清除、焚烧植被后形成的暂时性耕作地块，不是任何被火烧过的土地。

senses.pos: n. 可数名词（农业或人类学）
senses.meaning_zh: 烧垦地；清除并焚烧植被后供暂时耕种的土地
senses.meaning_en: a plot cleared by cutting and burning vegetation for temporary cultivation
senses.english_definition: A swidden is an area of land where vegetation has been cut and burned so that crops can be grown, usually for a limited period.
senses.collocation_en: clear a swidden; cultivate a swidden
senses.collocation_zh: 开辟一块烧垦地；耕种烧垦地
senses.sentence_en: The farmers grew rice on the swidden before leaving it fallow.
senses.sentence_zh: 农民们先在这块烧垦地上种植水稻，随后让土地休耕。

senses.pos: n. 不可数名词（农业或人类学）
senses.meaning_zh: 烧垦耕作；以烧垦和休耕轮换为特点的耕作方式
senses.meaning_en: cultivation involving the cutting and burning of vegetation, commonly with fallow periods
senses.english_definition: Swidden is a way of farming in which vegetation is cut and burned before crops are planted, and cultivated plots are commonly later left fallow.
senses.collocation_en: swidden agriculture; swidden cultivation
senses.collocation_zh: 烧垦农业；烧垦耕作
senses.sentence_en: The study examines how swidden supports local food production.
senses.sentence_zh: 这项研究考察烧垦耕作如何支持当地的粮食生产。

etymology_story.zh: 该词来自表示“烧出的空地”的英语方言词，通常被认为与古诺尔斯语 sviðinn（烧焦的）有关。它后来成为农业和人类学术语，既指烧垦形成的地块，也指相应的耕作方式。
etymology_story.en: The word comes from an English dialect term for a clearing made by burning and is generally linked to Old Norse sviðinn, 'burned.' It became an agricultural and anthropological term for both the cleared plot and the associated farming practice.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 swidden 通常作为不可再分的词基使用，不宜强拆为熟悉的英语词缀。词族包括 swiddens（复数）、swiddener（烧垦农作者）和 swiddening（烧垦活动）；swidden agriculture 和 swidden cultivation 中的 swidden 是名词作定语。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, swidden is normally treated as an unanalyzed base rather than divided into familiar English affixes. Its family includes swiddens, swiddener, and swiddening; in swidden agriculture and swidden cultivation, swidden functions as a noun modifier.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: slash-and-burn cultivation（刀耕火种）突出砍伐与焚烧这两个步骤；shifting cultivation（迁移耕作）强调耕地轮换与休耕，并不必然使用火；clearing（清理出的空地）不限定农业用途或清理方法。swidden 特指烧垦地或烧垦耕作。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Slash-and-burn cultivation emphasizes cutting and burning; shifting cultivation emphasizes movement between plots and fallow periods and does not necessarily involve fire; clearing does not specify farming or a method of clearance. Swidden specifically names a burned cultivation plot or the associated practice.

mnemonic_anchor.en: Picture vegetation burned to ash and crops planted in the clearing: swidden names the plot and the practice.

etymology_story.zh: 该词经法语 syndic 和晚期拉丁语 syndicus，源于希腊语 syndikos，意为“诉讼助手、代表”，其中 syn- 表示“共同”，dikē 表示“正义、诉讼”。其含义从替他人出面处理诉讼的人，扩展到机构事务代表及某些法律体系中的破产管理人。
etymology_story.en: The word came through French syndic and Late Latin syndicus from Greek syndikos, 'legal helper or advocate,' combining syn-, 'together,' with dikē, 'justice or a legal action.' Its meaning broadened from legal representation to institutional administration and, in some legal systems, insolvency administration.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 syndic 通常作为完整词基使用；syn- + dik- 是历史词源分析，不是现代英语中可自由套用的构词公式。复数为 syndics；相关词族包括 syndicate（辛迪加；组成联合组织）、syndication（联合经营；内容联合发行）和 syndicator（联合经营者；内容发行商），其现代含义已进一步分化。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern English normally treats syndic as a whole base; syn- + dik- is a historical analysis rather than a productive modern word-building formula. Its plural is syndics; related family members include syndicate, syndication, and syndicator, whose modern meanings have developed in distinct directions.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: representative（代表）最宽泛，只强调代为出面；trustee（受托人）强调依受托职责管理财产或事务；administrator（管理人）强调实际管理职能。syndic 是特定机构或法律制度中的职称，不能在所有语境中与这些词互换。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Representative broadly means someone acting for others; trustee emphasizes entrusted responsibilities for property or affairs; administrator emphasizes practical management. Syndic is a title used in particular institutions or legal systems, so these terms are not universally interchangeable.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 共同的法律事务，需要一人代表：从“替大家出面”记住 syndic。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Shared legal affairs need someone to speak for the group: remember a syndic as the appointed representative.

etymology_story.zh: 源于拉丁语 tactus，意为“触摸、触觉”，与 tangere“触摸”有关。英语加上形容词后缀形成 tactual，主要用于心理学、教育等领域，描述通过触摸获得的感觉或信息。
etymology_story.en: Tactual comes from Latin tactus, meaning 'touch' or 'the sense of touch,' related to tangere, 'to touch.' The English adjective is used especially in psychology and education for sensations or information obtained through touch.

morphology_enriched.zh: tactu-（源于 tactus 的词干，表示“触摸”）+ -al（形容词后缀）→ tactual；直接派生词：tactually（通过触觉地）。相关同源词：tactile（触觉的）、tactility（触觉性质；可触知性）。
morphology_enriched.en: tactu- (a stem based on tactus, 'touch') + -al (adjective suffix) → tactual. Direct derivative: tactually. Related formations from the same historical base include tactile and tactility.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: tactile（触觉的）最通用，也可强调物体的触感；haptic（触觉的）常用于主动触摸、动作感知及反馈技术；tactual 较正式，常描述触觉感知和学习。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Tactile is the usual general term and can describe an object's feel; haptic often concerns active touch, movement-related perception, or feedback technology. Tactual is more formal and commonly describes perception and learning through touch.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: tactu- 表示“触摸”：手摸到的信息，就是 tactual information。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Connect tactu- with touch: information your fingers discover is tactual information.

usage_note: 本课只教足部的跗骨义。tarsal 还可用于眼睑结构；足部 tarsal 与手部 carpal 要分清。

senses.meaning_zh: 跗部的；跗骨的；昆虫跗节的

etymology_story.zh: 来自 tarsus 加形容词后缀 -al；tarsus 经医学拉丁语追溯至希腊语 tarsos，曾表示扁平表面、脚掌等。这个解剖学名称后来也用于眼睑中的睑板，因此 tarsal 兼有足部和眼睑方面的含义。
etymology_story.en: Tarsal is formed from tarsus and the adjective suffix -al; tarsus comes through medical Latin from Greek tarsos, a word used for a flat surface or the sole of the foot. The anatomical term was also applied to the supporting plate in an eyelid, giving tarsal its eyelid-related meaning.

morphology_enriched.zh: tarsus 去掉拉丁语词尾 -us，取词干 tars- + -al → tarsal；形容词转作名词后表示“一块跗骨”，复数为 tarsals。相关词族：tarsus（跗部；睑板，复数 tarsi）、intertarsal（跗骨间的）、metatarsal（跖骨的；跖骨）、tarsometatarsal（跗跖的）。
morphology_enriched.en: Remove the Latin ending -us from tarsus and add -al to the stem tars- → tarsal. The adjective also functions as a noun meaning a tarsal bone, with plural tarsals. Related formations include tarsus (plural tarsi), intertarsal, metatarsal, and tarsometatarsal.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: tarsal bone 与名词 tarsal 等义，表达更明确；ankle bone（踝部骨骼）是日常概称，与跗骨范围不完全重合；palpebral（眼睑的）指整个眼睑，范围比表示“睑板的”的 tarsal 更广。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Tarsal bone is an explicit equivalent of the noun tarsal. Ankle bone is an everyday expression whose anatomical scope does not exactly match tarsal. Palpebral concerns the eyelid generally, whereas eyelid-related tarsal specifically concerns its supporting plate.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 抓住 tarsus：足部的跗部、眼睑的睑板，相关结构都可用 tarsal。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Anchor tarsal to tarsus: the foot's tarsus and the eyelid's supporting plate share this anatomical name.

meaning: 热成像（将热辐射差异显示成图像的技术）
aliases: 热成像（将热辐射差异显示成图像的技术）

pronunciation.note: 采用美式读音；ˈ 标主重音，ˌ 标次重音。

forms: 技术名通常不可数；thermographic 为形容词。
family: thermographer 热成像操作人员；thermographic 热成像的。

morphology.text: thermo-（热） + -graphy（记录、成像）→ thermography（热成像）。

etymology.text: 英语用希腊语来源的 thermo-“热”和 -graphy“记录”造词。它曾指利用热显字的工艺，后来也指用红外辐射记录温度差异。

usage_note: 本课是红外热成像义，用于显示热分布；不是普通可见光摄影，也不是印刷中的热凸印义。

senses.meaning_zh: 热成像；尤指红外热成像
senses.meaning_en: the production of images showing temperature differences, especially using infrared radiation

etymology_story.zh: 由希腊语来源的 thermo-（热）和 -graphy（书写、记录）组合而成，字面意为“用热记录”或“记录热”。这个名称曾用于借助热进行复制的工艺，也用于记录温度分布，现代尤其常指红外热成像。
etymology_story.en: Thermography combines Greek-derived thermo-, 'heat,' with -graphy, 'writing or recording,' suggesting recording with heat or recording heat itself. The name has been used for heat-assisted reproduction processes and for recording temperature patterns, especially through modern infrared imaging.

morphology_enriched.zh: thermo-（热）+ -graphy（记录过程或技术）→ thermography。主要词族：thermograph（温度记录仪）、thermogram（热像图；温度记录图）、thermographic（热成像的；热印刷的）、thermographically（以热成像或热印刷方式）、thermographer（热成像技术人员）。
morphology_enriched.en: thermo- (heat) + -graphy (a recording process or technique) → thermography. The main family includes thermograph, thermogram, thermographic, thermographically, and thermographer.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: thermal imaging（热成像）是成像义最常见的近义表达；infrared imaging（红外成像）范围更广，并非所有红外成像都用于显示温度；raised printing（凸起效果印刷）描述印刷效果，也可由其他工艺实现。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Thermal imaging is the usual equivalent for the imaging sense. Infrared imaging is broader because infrared images do not always represent temperature. Raised printing describes a printing result that can also be achieved by processes other than thermography.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: thermo- 是“热”，-graphy 是“记录”：把热画出来，或用热把字印凸起来。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Heat plus recording: make heat visible in an image, or use heat to raise printed lettering.

meaning: 超越特定历史时期的；跨历史时代的

pronunciation.note: 采用美式读音；ˈ 标主重音，ˌ 标次重音。

forms: 形容词，无复数或时态变化。

morphology.text: trans-（跨越） + historical（历史的）→ transhistorical（跨越特定历史界限的）。

etymology.text: 这是英语以前缀 trans-“跨越”接 historical 形成的词。trans- 来自拉丁语，historical 的基础 history 经法语、拉丁语追溯到希腊语 historia“探究、记述”。

usage_note: 多见于历史、文学和哲学论述，表示超越某一时代的界限，不保证某种现象在所有时代都完全一样。

senses.meaning_zh: 跨历史时期的；超越特定历史条件的
senses.meaning_en: extending across historical periods or beyond a particular historical context
senses.english_definition: Something transhistorical exists or applies across different historical periods rather than belonging only to one period.
senses.collocation_en: transhistorical categories; transhistorical truths
senses.collocation_zh: 跨历史时期的范畴；超越特定历史条件的真理
senses.sentence_en: The essay questions whether justice can be understood as a transhistorical ideal.
senses.sentence_zh: 这篇文章探讨了能否将正义理解为一种超越特定历史条件的理想。

etymology_story.zh: 英语以前缀 trans-（跨越、超越）加 historical（历史的）构成，表示跨越时代或超出单一历史背景。trans- 来自拉丁语；historical 所属的 history 词族经法语和拉丁语追溯至希腊语 historia，原有“探究、记述”之意。
etymology_story.en: English formed transhistorical by adding trans-, 'across or beyond,' to historical, expressing extension across periods or beyond a single historical setting. Trans- is Latin, while the history family ultimately goes through French and Latin to Greek historia, 'inquiry or an account.'

morphology_enriched.zh: trans-（跨越）+ historical（历史的）→ transhistorical；historical 属于 history + -ical 的派生词族，构词时 history 的词尾 -y 脱落。直接派生词：transhistorically（跨历史时期地）；相关词族：history（历史）、historic（有重大历史意义的）、historical（历史的）、historically（从历史上看）、historian（历史学家）、historicity（历史真实性；历史性）。
morphology_enriched.en: trans- (across or beyond) + historical → transhistorical. Historical belongs to the history + -ical formation, with final -y removed. The direct adverb is transhistorically; related family members include history, historic, historical, historically, historian, and historicity.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: timeless（不受时间限制的）常强调持久价值；ahistorical（脱离历史背景的）常指忽视历史条件，可能带批评意味；跨越多个时代的 transhistorical 不一定忽视各时代的历史差异。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Timeless often emphasizes lasting value or relevance. Ahistorical means detached from historical context and can criticize a failure to consider history. Transhistorical indicates extension across periods without necessarily denying historical differences.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: trans- = 跨越：把同一个问题放进多个历史时代，就是 transhistorical。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Trans- means across: follow the same question across historical periods.

meaning: 三氯乙烯（一种工业溶剂）
aliases: 三氯乙烯（一种工业溶剂）

pronunciation.note: 采用美式读音；ˈ 标主重音，ˌ 标次重音。

forms: 化学物质名通常不可数；常缩写为 TCE。
family: trichloroethene 三氯乙烯的另一名称；ethylene 乙烯。

morphology.text: tri-（三） + chloro-（氯） + ethylene（乙烯）→ trichloroethylene（三氯乙烯）。

etymology.text: 现代英语化学名称由 tri-、chloro- 与 ethylene 组合；“三氯”对应分子中的三个氯原子。用“三个氯加在乙烯骨架上”的图景记名称。

usage_note: 化学品通用名通常小写；TCE 通常大写。它是有毒物质，词形中的 tri- 指三个，不表示三种溶剂混合。

senses.meaning_zh: 三氯乙烯；一种无色、易挥发的氯代有机溶剂

senses.english_definition: Trichloroethylene is a colorless liquid used as an industrial solvent, especially for removing grease from metal.
senses.collocation_en: trichloroethylene contamination; exposure to trichloroethylene
senses.collocation_zh: 三氯乙烯污染；三氯乙烯暴露

senses.sentence_zh: 实验室检测了地下水样品中的三氯乙烯。

etymology_story.zh: 这个化学名称由 tri-（三）、chloro-（氯）和 ethylene（乙烯）组合而成，表示乙烯分子中的三个氢原子被氯原子取代。chloro- 所属的 chlorine 词族最终与希腊语 chlōros“黄绿色的”有关，呼应氯气的颜色。
etymology_story.en: The chemical name combines tri-, 'three,' chloro-, 'chlorine,' and ethylene, indicating ethylene with three hydrogen atoms replaced by chlorine atoms. The chlorine family ultimately reflects Greek chlōros, 'yellowish green,' referring to the gas's color.

morphology_enriched.zh: tri-（三）+ chloro-（氯取代）+ ethylene（乙烯）→ trichloroethylene，结构式为 CHCl=CCl₂。等义名称：trichloroethene（三氯乙烯）；常见缩写：TCE。本词没有常用的普通派生词；ethylene（乙烯）、dichloroethylene（二氯乙烯）、tetrachloroethylene（四氯乙烯）是相关化合物名称，不能互换。
morphology_enriched.en: tri- (three) + chloro- (chlorine substitution) + ethylene → trichloroethylene, structurally CHCl=CCl₂. The equivalent name is trichloroethene, commonly abbreviated TCE. There are no common general-purpose derivatives; ethylene, dichloroethylene, and tetrachloroethylene name related but different compounds.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: trichloroethene 是同一物质采用 ethene 命名形式的名称；TCE 是常见缩写，但脱离语境可能有其他含义；chlorinated solvent（氯代溶剂）是上位类别名称，不能精确指明三氯乙烯。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Trichloroethene names the same compound using the ethene form. TCE is a common abbreviation but can have other meanings outside this context. Chlorinated solvent names the broader class and does not uniquely identify this substance.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 乙烯骨架，三个氢换成氯：tri（三）+ chloro（氯）+ ethylene（乙烯）。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Start with ethylene and replace three hydrogens with chlorine: tri + chloro + ethylene.

meaning: 三语的；使用三种语言的

pronunciation.note: 采用美式读音；ˈ 标主重音，ˌ 标次重音。

forms: 形容词，无复数或时态变化；副词 trilingually。
family: bilingual 双语的；multilingual 多语的。

morphology.text: tri-（三） + lingu-（语言） + -al（……的）→ trilingual（三语的）。

etymology.text: 英语以 tri-“三”和拉丁语 lingua“舌、语言”为基础造词。“三条舌头”可作为会用三种语言的记忆画面。

usage_note: 可修饰会用三种语言的人，也可修饰以三种语言编排的材料。tri- 明确是三；multilingual 不限定恰好三种。

etymology_story.zh: 该词以表示“三”的 tri- 和源自拉丁语 lingua“舌；语言”的 lingual 为基础构成，与 bilingual“双语的”结构平行。其意义既可指人的三语能力，也可指文本或交流使用三种语言。
etymology_story.en: The word combines tri-, meaning 'three,' with lingual, ultimately from Latin lingua, 'tongue; language,' following the same pattern as bilingual. It describes both competence in three languages and material or communication presented in three languages.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代构词：tri-（三）+ lingual（语言的）→ trilingual。主要词族：trilingually（三语地）、trilingualism（三语能力；三语使用现象）、trilinguality（三语属性，较少用）；名词复数为 trilinguals。平行构词包括 monolingual（单语的）、bilingual（双语的）和 multilingual（多语的）。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern formation: tri- ('three') + lingual ('relating to language') → trilingual. Principal family members are trilingually, trilingualism, and the less common trilinguality; the count noun has the plural trilinguals. Parallel formations include monolingual, bilingual, and multilingual.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: three-language（使用三种语言的）主要修饰词典、版本等事物；multilingual（多语的）不限定语言数量；polyglot（通晓多种语言的；多语者）通常强调掌握多种语言。trilingual 则明确限定为三种语言。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Three-language mainly describes things such as dictionaries or editions; multilingual leaves the number of languages unspecified; polyglot commonly emphasizes a person's command of several languages. Trilingual specifically identifies three languages.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: tri-＝三，lingual＝语言的：同一个人能在三种语言之间切换。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Tri- means three: picture one speaker switching among three languages.

meaning: 转子（股骨上端供肌肉附着的骨突）
aliases: 转子（股骨上端供肌肉附着的骨突）

pronunciation.note: 采用美式读音；ˈ 标主重音，ˌ 标次重音。

forms: 单数 trochanter；复数 trochanters。
family: trochanteric 转子的；trochanteral 转子部的。

morphology.text: trochanter 作为独立词素记忆；trochanter + -ic → trochanteric（转子的）。

etymology.text: 来自希腊语 trochanter，与表示“跑”的 trechein 有亲缘联系。可联想大腿肌肉附着在这个骨突上，参与腿部运动。

usage_note: 本课取人体股骨转子义，常见 greater trochanter、lesser trochanter。昆虫学另用来指腿的转节，不与本课混考。

senses.meaning_zh: 转子，股骨上端供肌肉附着的骨突

senses.english_definition: A trochanter is one of the two bony projections near the top of the thigh bone where muscles attach.

senses.english_definition: An insect's trochanter is the small leg segment between the segment nearest its body and the femur.
senses.collocation_en: the insect trochanter; the trochanter and femur

etymology_story.zh: 该词经新拉丁语借自希腊语 trokhantēr，古希腊语中已有相关解剖学用法，并与 trekhein“跑”有关。英语中先用于股骨的骨突，后来也用于昆虫足部的一节。
etymology_story.en: The word entered through New Latin from Greek trokhantēr, which already had an anatomical use and was related to trekhein, 'to run.' English uses it for projections on the femur and, by extension, a segment of an insect's leg.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中将 trochanter 视为完整词基，不宜强行拆成常见英语词缀。主要词族：trochanters（复数）、trochanteric（转子的）、intertrochanteric（转子间的）、subtrochanteric（转子下的）、pertrochanteric（转子周围的）。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, trochanter functions as a whole base rather than a transparent combination of ordinary English affixes. Principal family members are trochanters, trochanteric, intertrochanteric, subtrochanteric, and pertrochanteric.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: 无严格同义词。相关解剖术语中，process（突）泛指骨性突起，tuberosity（粗隆）指通常较粗糙、供组织附着的隆起，tubercle（结节）通常指较小的骨突；trochanter 特指股骨上的大转子或小转子。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: There is no exact synonym. Among related anatomical terms, process is a general bony projection, tuberosity is a usually roughened prominence for attachment, and tubercle usually denotes a smaller projection; trochanter specifically names the greater or lesser projection of the femur.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 把“跑”与大腿肌肉的附着点相连：肌肉牵动股骨，转子提供着力处。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Connect the historical idea of running with the thigh muscles' attachment points on the femur.

pronunciation.note: 采用美式读音；ˈ 标主重音，ˌ 标次重音。

forms: 指细胞层时常用单数或整体名词；trophoblastic 是形容词。
family: trophoblastic 滋养层的；trophoblast cell 滋养层细胞。

morphology.text: tropho-（营养） + -blast（胚芽、未成熟细胞）→ trophoblast（滋养层）。

etymology.text: 这是国际科技词，用希腊语来源的 tropho-“营养”和 -blast“胚芽”组合。名称提示这层细胞与胚胎营养和着床有关。

usage_note: 指哺乳动物囊胚的外层，与内细胞团不同；它有助于着床，并参与胎盘相关结构形成。

senses.pos: n. 名词（胚胎学，通常作不可数名词）
senses.meaning_zh: 滋养层，囊胚外层参与着床并形成胎盘部分结构的细胞层
senses.meaning_en: the outer cell layer of a blastocyst that contributes to implantation and the placenta
senses.english_definition: The trophoblast is the outer layer of cells in an early embryo that helps it implant in the uterus and forms part of the placenta.
senses.collocation_en: trophoblast cells; trophoblast invasion
senses.collocation_zh: 滋养层细胞；滋养层侵入
senses.sentence_en: The trophoblast helps the blastocyst attach to the lining of the uterus.
senses.sentence_zh: 滋养层帮助囊胚附着于子宫内膜。

etymology_story.zh: 这是由希腊语来源的 tropho-“营养；滋养”和 -blast“芽；胚芽”组合而成的科学术语。名称强调这一细胞层在胚胎与母体建立联系、支持胚胎营养方面的作用。
etymology_story.en: This scientific term combines Greek-derived tropho-, 'nourishment,' with -blast, 'sprout; germ.' Its name emphasizes the layer's role in establishing contact with maternal tissues and supporting embryonic nutrition.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代构词：tropho-（营养；滋养）+ -blast（胚芽；未成熟细胞）→ trophoblast。主要词族与复合词：trophoblastic（滋养层的）、trophoblasts（指单个滋养层细胞时的复数）、cytotrophoblast（细胞滋养层）、syncytiotrophoblast（合体滋养层）。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern formation: tropho- ('nourishment') + -blast ('germ; immature cell') → trophoblast. Principal family members and compounds include trophoblastic, trophoblasts when individual cells are meant, cytotrophoblast, and syncytiotrophoblast.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: 无适用于所有阶段的严格同义词。trophectoderm（滋养外胚层）常指着床前囊胚的外层细胞；cytotrophoblast（细胞滋养层）是滋养层分化形成的一类细胞层；chorion（绒毛膜）除滋养层外还包含胚外中胚层，因此不能直接等同。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: There is no exact synonym valid at every developmental stage. Trophectoderm commonly names the outer cells of the preimplantation blastocyst; cytotrophoblast is a differentiated cellular component of trophoblast; the chorion also includes extraembryonic mesoderm and is therefore not identical to trophoblast.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: tropho-＝营养：囊胚外面的一层细胞，帮助胚胎“安家并获得供养”。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Tropho- signals nourishment: remember the embryo's outer layer helping it settle in and obtain support.

meaning: 铜绿（铜、黄铜或青铜表面的蓝绿色沉积物）
aliases: 铜绿（铜、黄铜或青铜表面的蓝绿色沉积物）

pronunciation.note: 采用美式读音；ˈ 标主重音，ˌ 标次重音。

forms: 物质名通常不可数；可说 a layer of verdigris。
family: verdigrised 生铜绿的；patina 表面形成的色层。

morphology.text: verdigris 作为独立词素记忆；verdigris + -ed → verdigrised（生了铜绿的）。不要按现代英语的 green 或 grey 强行拆开。

etymology.text: 中古英语从盎格鲁法语 vert de Grece 借入，字面是“希腊之绿”。后来拼写受法语 gris“灰色”影响；记住的颜色仍是铜表面的蓝绿色。

relations.meaning: 金属等表面形成的色层

etymology_story.zh: 该词经中古英语借自盎格鲁法语中意为“希腊之绿”的表达，其中包含 vert“绿”和 Grece“希腊”。后来的词形受法语 gris“灰色”影响，但词义始终与铜产生的绿色或蓝绿色物质有关。
etymology_story.en: The word reached Middle English from an Anglo-French expression meaning 'green of Greece,' containing vert, 'green,' and Grece, 'Greece.' Its later form was influenced by French gris, 'grey,' although its meaning remained associated with green or blue-green copper substances.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 verdigris 是不可再作透明分析的借词，不应按英语 green 或 grey 拆解。主要词族：verdigris（名词及动词）、verdigrises（动词第三人称单数）、verdigrised（过去式、过去分词；也可作分词形容词）、verdigrising（现在分词）。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, verdigris is an opaque loanword and should not be broken into English green or grey. Its principal family consists of the noun and verb verdigris and the verb forms verdigrises, verdigrised, and verdigrising; verdigrised also functions as a participial adjective.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: patina（包浆；表面氧化层）范围更广，不限于铜或绿色；copper corrosion（铜腐蚀；铜的腐蚀产物）强调化学变化，颜色和成分不限；green rust（绿锈）有时在非技术语境中指铜绿，但技术上也可指特定的含铁腐蚀产物，不能作为精确同义词。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Patina is broader and need not involve copper or a green color; copper corrosion emphasizes chemical deterioration without specifying one color or compound. Green rust can informally refer to verdigris, but technically it can denote particular iron corrosion products, so it is not an exact synonym.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 抓住历史上的“绿”：看到旧铜像表面的蓝绿色，就想到 verdigris。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Anchor the word to its historical 'green': picture the blue-green coating on an old copper statue.

meaning: 整套可用手段和装备（尤指医疗方面）

整套可用手段和装备（尤指医疗方面）

pronunciation.note: 采用美式读音；ˈ 标主重音，ˌ 标次重音。

forms: 单数 armamentarium；复数 armamentaria。
family: armament 装备；armamentaria 是本词复数。

morphology.text: armament-（装备） + -arium（存放处、集合）→ armamentarium（整套可用装备和手段）。

etymology.text: 借自拉丁语 armamentarium“军械库”，由 armamenta“装备、器具”和 -arium 构成。由“武器库”引申成完成工作可动用的整套工具。

usage_note: 正式书面语，医学中可同时涵盖器械、药物和方法；不一定是一个装器具的实物箱子。

etymology_story.zh: 该词借自拉丁语 armamentarium“军械库”，由 armamenta“装备；器具”和表示场所的 -arium 构成。英语将“存放装备的地方”引申为可供使用的整套装备和手段，尤其常见于医学。
etymology_story.en: The word comes from Latin armamentarium, 'arsenal,' formed from armamenta, 'equipment; implements,' and the place-forming suffix -arium. English extended the idea of an equipment store to the complete resources available for a task, especially in medicine.

morphology_enriched.zh: 该词是整体借入的拉丁词；可辨认的构词结构为 armament-（装备）+ -arium（存放处）。主要词形：armamentarium（单数）、armamentaria 或 armamentariums（复数）；同源词包括 arm（武装；武器）、arms（武器）、armament（军备；武装）。
morphology_enriched.en: The word was borrowed as a whole from Latin, with the recognizable structure armament- ('equipment') + -arium ('a place for keeping something'). Its plurals are armamentaria and armamentariums. Related words from the same historical family include arm, arms, and armament.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: toolkit（工具箱；方法集）较通俗，强调实用工具和技巧；arsenal（武器库；可用手段）保留较强的军事或竞争色彩；repertoire（全部技能或手法）更侧重掌握的技能和惯用方法。armamentarium 最正式，尤其适合指医疗领域整套可用资源。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Toolkit is more everyday and emphasizes practical tools and techniques; arsenal retains stronger military or competitive associations; repertoire focuses on skills and methods someone has mastered. Armamentarium is the most formal and is especially associated with the full resources available in medicine.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 从“军械库”想到医生的“治疗工具库”：器械、药物、方法都在其中。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Picture a doctor's arsenal: equipment, medicines, and methods gathered into one complete resource.

meaning: 自成的（由生态系统内生物活动引起的）
aliases: 由生物自身活动引起的
自成的（由生态系统内生物活动引起的）

pronunciation.note: 采用美式读音；ˈ 标主重音，ˌ 标次重音。

forms: 形容词，无复数或时态变化；本课限定生态学义。
family: allogenic 外成的；autogenous 自生的（相关形容词）。

morphology.text: auto-（自身） + -genic（产生、引起的）→ autogenic（自身因素引起的）。

etymology.text: 英语用希腊语来源的 auto-“自身”和 -genic“产生的”造词。生态学家坦斯利用它描述生物活动推动的演替，可想象植物逐渐改变自己生长的环境。

relations.meaning: 外成的；由外部因素引起的

usage_note: 本课指生态系统中生物本身改变环境所造成的变化；不要把外部洪水、火山喷发等因素造成的变化混入。

senses.meaning_zh: 自生的；由自身内部因素产生的

senses.meaning_zh: 自成的；由群落中的生物改变环境而引起的

etymology_story.zh: 该词由希腊语来源的 auto-“自身”和 -genic“产生的”构成，核心含义是“从自身内部产生”。这一含义后来用于描述生态系统的内部变化，也用于以自我暗示诱导放松的心理训练。
etymology_story.en: The word combines Greek-derived auto-, meaning “self,” with -genic, meaning “produced or generated.” Its central idea of internal generation extends to ecological change and to relaxation training based on self-suggestion.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代构词：auto-（自身）＋-genic（产生的）→ autogenic。词族与相关形式：autogenically（自生地，副词）、autogenous（自生的，相关形容词）、autogeny／autogenesis（自生、自发生成；具体意义随学科而异）；这些相关形式不全是直接由 autogenic 派生。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern structure: auto- (self) + -genic (generated) → autogenic. Family and related forms include autogenically (adverb), autogenous (a related adjective), and autogeny/autogenesis (nouns whose technical meanings vary by discipline); these are not all direct derivatives of autogenic.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: self-generated（自行产生的）最直白、适用面最广；endogenous（内源性的）强调来源在系统内部；autogenous（自生的）与 autogenic 接近，但各专业领域的固定搭配不同。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Self-generated is the plainest and broadest equivalent; endogenous emphasizes an internal source; autogenous is closely related, but established technical usage and collocations differ across disciplines.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: auto-＝自己，-genic＝产生：变化从“自己内部”发生。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Auto- means self; -genic means generated: the change comes from within.

pronunciation.note: 采用美式读音；ˈ 标主重音，ˌ 标次重音。

forms: 作形容词使用，无复数变化；词尾 -ed 在此读 /d/。
family: ribbon 丝带；beribbon 用丝带装饰。

morphology.text: be-（使带有） + ribbon（丝带） + -ed（具有……的）→ beribboned（饰有丝带的）。

etymology.text: 英语先以 be- 和 ribbon 形成“用丝带装饰”的词，再接 -ed。想象礼物、帽子或花束上系满丝带的样子。

usage_note: 偏描写性、书面语，常修饰帽子、花束、礼品等。强调丝带装饰，不泛指用任何材料装饰。

etymology_story.zh: 该词属于英语用 be- 表示“使带有、覆盖上”的构词传统，以 ribbon“丝带”为基础形成 beribbon“用丝带装饰”，其过去分词 beribboned 随后用作形容词。它的意义始终围绕丝带装饰，并没有显著的语义转变。
etymology_story.en: The word follows the English pattern in which be- means “provide or cover with”: ribbon gives beribbon, “decorate with ribbons,” and its past participle becomes an adjective. Its meaning has remained closely tied to ribbon decoration.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代构词：be-（使带有）＋ribbon（丝带）＋-ed（过去分词／形容词标记）→ beribboned。直接词族：beribbon（动词，较少见）、beribbons、beribboning、beribboned；基础词及相关形式：ribbon、ribbons、ribboned、ribboning、ribbonlike。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern structure: be- (provide with) + ribbon + -ed (participial/adjectival ending) → beribboned. The direct family includes the uncommon verb beribbon and its forms beribbons, beribboning, and beribboned; related base-word forms include ribbon, ribbons, ribboned, ribboning, and ribbonlike.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: ribboned（饰有丝带的）意义最接近；adorned（装饰着的）不限定装饰材料；bedecked（盛装装饰的）通常暗示装饰繁多、显眼。

meaning: 生物测定（借助生物反应测定物质效力）
aliases: 生物测定（借助生物反应测定物质效力）

pronunciation.note: 采用美式读音；ˈ 标主重音，ˌ 标次重音。

forms: 单数 bioassay；复数 bioassays。本课为名词，另有动词用法。

usage_note: 不是所有生物学实验都叫 bioassay；关键是用生物反应来衡量物质的活性或效力，常与标准样品比较。

etymology_story.zh: 该词由 bio-“生命、生物”和 assay“检验、测定”组合而成，用于指以生物反应衡量物质作用的方法。Assay 经古法语传入英语，其历史可追溯到表示“称量”的拉丁语词。
etymology_story.en: Bioassay combines bio-, meaning “life,” with assay, meaning “test,” to name measurement through biological responses. Assay entered English through Old French and ultimately traces back to a Latin word associated with weighing.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代构词：bio-（生物）＋assay（测定）→ bioassay；同形兼作名词和动词。直接词形：bioassays（名词复数／动词第三人称单数）、bioassayed（过去式／过去分词）、bioassaying（现在分词／动名词）；基础词族包括 assay、assayer（检验者）。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern structure: bio- (biological) + assay (test) → bioassay, used as both noun and verb. Direct forms are bioassays (plural noun or third-person singular verb), bioassayed (past tense and participle), and bioassaying (present participle or gerund); the base family includes assay and assayer.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: biological assay（生物测定）是展开形式，意义基本相同；biological test（生物试验）范围更广，不一定用于定量；potency assay（效力测定）强调效力，不能涵盖所有毒性或浓度测定。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Biological assay is the expanded equivalent; biological test is broader and need not be quantitative; potency assay specifically measures strength or activity and does not cover every toxicity or concentration measurement.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: bio-＋assay：让生物反应充当“测量仪”。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Bio- + assay: let a biological response act as the measuring instrument.

usage_note: 主要见于电影史及评论，常谈二十世纪七十年代的美国电影潮流。不是所有黑人导演、演员参与的电影都属于这一类型。

etymology_story.zh: 该词在20世纪70年代初的美国电影评论中出现，由 Black“黑人”和 exploitation“商业利用、剥削”融合而成。它既成为电影类型名称，也保留了对商业化利用黑人形象及刻板印象的批评意味。
etymology_story.en: The term emerged in American film criticism in the early 1970s as a blend of Black and exploitation. It became a genre label while retaining criticism of the commercial exploitation of Black images and stereotypes.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代构词：Black＋exploitation → blaxploitation，属于融合词；blax- 在此不是独立、通用的前缀。相关形式：blaxploitation film（黑人剥削电影，名词作定语）、blaxploitation-era（黑人剥削电影时代的，复合修饰语）；来源词族包括 exploit、exploitation、exploitative、exploiter，本词没有常用的独立动词派生形式。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern formation: Black + exploitation → blaxploitation, a blend; blax- is not an independent general-purpose prefix here. Related constructions include blaxploitation film (attributive noun use) and blaxploitation-era (a compound modifier); the source family includes exploit, exploitation, exploitative, and exploiter, but the blend has no common independent verb derivative.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: Black exploitation cinema（黑人剥削电影）是解释性近义表达；exploitation cinema（剥削电影）是更大的类型，依靠刺激性题材吸引观众；Black cinema（黑人电影）范围更广，不能作为本词的等义替换。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Black exploitation cinema is an explanatory equivalent; exploitation cinema is the broader category of films marketed through sensational material; Black cinema covers a much wider range of filmmaking and is not interchangeable with blaxploitation.

mnemonic_anchor.en: Black + exploitation: an exploitation-film genre built around Black characters and audiences.

usage_note: 多见于固定化学名称，如 boric acid。boric 是形容词，不是元素硼的名词名称 boron。

etymology_story.zh: 该词由表示硼的词干 bor- 与化学形容词后缀 -ic 构成，与 boron“硼”和 borax“硼砂”的命名历史相联系。这组名称最终与阿拉伯语、波斯语中表示硼砂的词有关，boric 后来固定用于 boric acid“硼酸”等名称。
etymology_story.en: Boric combines the bor- stem associated with boron with the chemical adjective suffix -ic, within the naming family of boron and borax. That family ultimately connects with Arabic and Persian words for borax, and boric became established in names such as boric acid.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代构词：bor-（硼，boron 的词干形式）＋-ic（……的）→ boric。相关化学词族：boron（硼）、borate（硼酸盐／硼酸酯）、boride（硼化物）、boronic（硼酸类的，见 boronic acid）、boronate（硼酸类化合物的盐或酯，依语境而定）；borax（硼砂）是历史相关词，并非由 boric 派生，boric 本身没有常用副词或名词派生形式。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern structure: bor- (the combining stem associated with boron) + -ic (adjectival suffix) → boric. Related chemical vocabulary includes boron, borate, boride, boronic, and boronate; borax is historically related rather than derived from boric, and boric itself has no common adverb or noun derivative.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: boron-containing（含硼的）范围较广，明确表示含有硼；boracic（硼的）是较旧的近义形式，常见于 boracic acid“硼酸”；boronic 虽同属硼化学词汇，却用于不同的化合物命名，不能与 boric 随意互换。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Boron-containing is broader and explicitly indicates the presence of boron; boracic is an older equivalent, especially in boracic acid; boronic belongs to related chemical terminology but identifies different compounds and is not freely interchangeable with boric.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: bor- 联想 boron“硼”，-ic 表示“……的”：boric acid＝硼酸。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Connect bor- with boron and -ic with “relating to”: boric acid is an acid of boron.

etymology_story.zh: 这道菜由威尼斯 Harry's Bar 的朱塞佩·奇普里亚尼创制，以画家维托雷·卡尔帕乔的姓氏命名，因为生牛肉的红色使他联想到这位画家的用色。名称后来扩展到其他肉类、鱼类及蔬果的薄片菜肴。
etymology_story.en: Giuseppe Cipriani created the dish at Harry's Bar in Venice and named it after the painter Vittore Carpaccio because the beef's red color recalled the painter's palette. The name later extended to similar preparations of fish, other meats, vegetables, and fruit. [Merriam-Webster: carpaccio](https://art19.com/shows/merriam-websters-word-of-the-day/episodes/c939453f-c655-4146-8a26-380a5e6ecbb2)

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中，carpaccio 是整体借入的词，不能可靠地拆成英语词根和词缀。常用形式与构词：carpaccios（不同菜品或多份的复数）；carpaccio + style → carpaccio-style（意式薄切风格的，复合形容词）。无常用的直接派生词；beef carpaccio 中的 beef 是名词修饰语，不能据此另立 carpaccio 的形容词词性。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, carpaccio is a borrowed base without a useful English root-and-affix division. Forms and compounds include carpaccios, referring to varieties or servings, and carpaccio + style → carpaccio-style, a compound adjective meaning prepared in this thinly sliced style. There are no common direct derivatives; noun-modifying constructions do not establish a separate adjective use of carpaccio.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: 没有完全对应的常用同义词。近义菜名：crudo（意式生食菜肴）范围较广；sashimi（日式刺身）属于日本料理，通常指生鱼片；steak tartare（鞑靼生牛肉）使用剁碎或切细的生牛肉，而 carpaccio 的关键是切成极薄的片。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: There is no common exact synonym. Crudo is a broader Italian culinary term for raw preparations; sashimi is a Japanese dish usually consisting of sliced raw fish; steak tartare uses finely chopped raw beef, whereas carpaccio characteristically uses very thin slices.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 画家的红色画布 → 盘中铺开的红色牛肉薄片；再联想到其他食材的薄切摆盘。
mnemonic_anchor.en: A painter's red canvas becomes a plate of paper-thin red beef; the same sliced presentation then extends to other ingredients.

senses.english_definition: A cephalosporin is one of a group of antibiotics that treat bacterial infections by interfering with the formation of bacterial cell walls.

etymology_story.zh: 名称来自曾使用的新拉丁语真菌属名 Cephalosporium，加上表示物质的后缀 -in，反映了早期头孢菌素来源于真菌的历史。后来，这个名称也用于以天然头孢菌素为基础制成的半合成抗生素。
etymology_story.en: The name combines the former New Latin fungal genus name Cephalosporium with the substance suffix -in, reflecting the fungal origin of the first cephalosporins. It subsequently also came to denote semisynthetic antibiotics developed from the natural compounds. [American Heritage Dictionary: cephalosporin](https://ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=CEPHALOSPORIN)

morphology_enriched.zh: 构词公式：Cephalosporium 去掉属名结尾 -ium，取词干 cephalospor- + -in（物质后缀）→ cephalosporin。形式与词族：cephalosporins（复数）；cephalosporin + -ase → cephalosporinase（头孢菌素酶）；cephalosporin-resistant（对头孢菌素耐药的，复合形容词）。更深层的 cephalo- 和 spor- 分别与“头”和“孢子”有关，但它们解释的是真菌名称，不能把药名直接释为“头部药物”。
morphology_enriched.en: Formation: remove the genus ending -ium from Cephalosporium, then combine cephalospor- + -in, a substance suffix, to form cephalosporin. Forms and family members include cephalosporins, the plural; cephalosporin + -ase → cephalosporinase, an enzyme that breaks down cephalosporins; and the compound adjective cephalosporin-resistant. The deeper elements cephalo- and spor- concern the fungal name's head-and-spore imagery, not a drug acting specifically on the head.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: cephalosporin antibiotic（头孢菌素类抗生素）是明确的同义表达；beta-lactam antibiotic（β-内酰胺类抗生素）是较大的上位类别，还包括青霉素等；antibiotic（抗生素）范围更广。后两者不能在需要准确标明药物类别时直接替换 cephalosporin。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Cephalosporin antibiotic is an explicit equivalent expression. Beta-lactam antibiotic names the broader class that also includes penicillins and other groups; antibiotic is broader still. These broader terms cannot replace cephalosporin when the precise drug class matters.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: Cephalosporium 真菌名 → cephalospor- + -in 物质名 → 头孢菌素。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Fungus name Cephalosporium → cephalospor- plus substance suffix -in → the antibiotic family.

etymology.text: 英语直接借自拉丁语 cerebrum“脑”。现代解剖学中用它指大脑，名称和相应形容词 cerebral 可以一起记。

usage_note: cerebrum 是脑的一部分，在人体指大脑；brain 的范围更广。不要和拼写相近的 cerebellum（小脑）混淆。

senses.meaning_en: The major part of the brain comprising the two cerebral hemispheres and their connecting structures.
senses.english_definition: Your cerebrum is the large upper part of your brain that is involved in conscious thought, memory, interpreting sensations, and voluntary movement.

etymology_story.zh: 英语在十六世纪借入拉丁语 cerebrum，原义为“脑”。在现代解剖学的主要用法中，它专指大脑半球及相关连接结构，而不是小脑或整个脑。
etymology_story.en: English borrowed Latin cerebrum, meaning brain, in the sixteenth century. In its principal modern anatomical use, it identifies the cerebral hemispheres and their connecting structures rather than the cerebellum or the entire brain. [Merriam-Webster: cerebrum](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/cerebrum)

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语将 cerebrum 作为拉丁语借词使用；-um 是保留的拉丁语名词结尾，不是可自由添加的英语后缀。复数为 cerebra 或 cerebrums。主要词族：cerebr- + -al → cerebral（大脑的；重思考的），cerebral + -ly → cerebrally（在大脑方面；在思维层面）；cerebrate（思考，正式且少用）、cerebration（思考活动，正式）。组合形式 cerebro- 见于 cerebrospinal（脑脊髓的）和 cerebrovascular（脑血管的）。
morphology_enriched.en: Cerebrum is a Latin loanword; -um is its retained Latin noun ending, not a freely productive English suffix. Its plurals are cerebra and cerebrums. The principal family includes cerebr- + -al → cerebral, relating to the cerebrum or emphasizing thought; cerebral + -ly → cerebrally; cerebrate, to think, formal and uncommon; and cerebration, mental activity, formal. The combining form cerebro- occurs in cerebrospinal and cerebrovascular.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: telencephalon（端脑）是最接近的技术对应词，在常见解剖学描述中与 cerebrum 基本对应；brain（脑）范围更大，还包括小脑和脑干；cerebral cortex（大脑皮质）仅指大脑的外层，不能替代整个 cerebrum。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Telencephalon is the closest technical equivalent and largely corresponds to cerebrum in standard anatomical descriptions. Brain is broader and also includes the cerebellum and brainstem; cerebral cortex refers only to the cerebrum's outer layer.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: cerebr- 锚定“大脑”：cerebrum 是器官名，cerebral 表示“大脑的”，再引申为“重思考的”。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Anchor cerebr- to the thinking brain: cerebrum names the structure, while cerebral means relating to it and, by extension, intellectual.

morphology.text: crypto-（隐藏、秘密） + -gram（写成的东西）→ cryptogram（密码文）。

etymology.text: 英语仿照 cryptograph、cryptography，用希腊语来源的 crypto-“隐藏”和 -gram“写下的东西”造词；可联想一段把意义藏起来的文字。

usage_note: 可指实际通信中的密码文，也常指报纸中的解码谜题。cryptogram 是信息成品，cryptography 是研究或实践领域。

etymology_story.zh: cryptogram 是英语利用希腊语来源的 crypto-（隐藏的）和 -gram（写成的东西）构造的词，受到 cryptograph 和 cryptography 等词的类推影响。它表示把内容隐藏起来的文字，也自然用于需要还原这类文字的密码字谜。
etymology_story.en: English formed cryptogram from the Greek-derived elements crypto-, hidden, and -gram, something written, by analogy with cryptograph and cryptography. Its use for concealed writing also lends itself to puzzles in which that writing must be deciphered. [Merriam-Webster: cryptogram](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/cryptogram)

morphology_enriched.zh: 构词公式：crypto-（隐藏、秘密）+ -gram（写成的信息或记录）→ cryptogram；复数 cryptograms。主要同根词族：cryptograph（密码文；密码书写装置，较少用）、cryptography（密码学；密码编制）、cryptographer（密码学家；密码编制者）、cryptographic / cryptographical（密码学的）、cryptographically（以密码学方式）。这些是共享词根的相关构词，不全是从 cryptogram 直接加后缀产生的词。
morphology_enriched.en: Formation: crypto-, hidden or secret, + -gram, a written message or record, → cryptogram; plural cryptograms. The principal related family includes cryptograph, an encoded text or a cipher-writing device, less common; cryptography, the practice or study of secure writing; cryptographer, a practitioner; cryptographic / cryptographical; and cryptographically. These share roots and are not all direct suffixal derivatives of cryptogram.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: ciphertext（密文）是密码学中指加密输出的技术词；coded message（编码信息；密码信息）是更直白、范围较宽的说法；cipher（密码；密码系统）有时也指密码文，但常指生成密文的方法。cryptogram 尤其容易让人想到一段可破译的文字或字谜。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Ciphertext is the technical term for the output of encryption; coded message is a plainer, broader expression. Cipher can mean an encoded message but often means the method used to produce it. Cryptogram particularly suggests a piece of concealed writing or a deciphering puzzle.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: crypto- 把意思藏起来，-gram 把它写下来：写出来却看不懂的密码文。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Crypto- hides the meaning; -gram puts it into writing: a written message with its meaning concealed.

pronunciation.note: 采用美式读音；ˈ 标主重音，ˌ 标次重音。

family: decalogue 也可泛指具有约束力的一套基本规则。

morphology.text: deca-（十） + -logue（言辞、条文）→ Decalogue（十条诫命）。

etymology.text: 希腊语 dekalogos 由“十”和“言辞”组成，经晚期拉丁语 decalogus 进入中古英语。字面“十句话”帮助记住十条诫命。

usage_note: 特指犹太教、基督教传统中的《十诫》时通常写 Decalogue，首字母大写，常与 the 连用；泛指规则集时可小写。
